name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – Motion for a resolution (text as a whole)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report does not change any law. It is the European Parliament's own assessment of how the EU's Recovery and Resilience Facility is working. The money is meant to help countries recover from the pandemic and the energy crisis, and it ends in 2026. The Parliament says progress is too slow, that only about half the money has been paid out, and that it is hard to see where the money ends up. It asks for faster payments, better tracking of who receives funds, and a clear plan to repay the EU's shared debt.

**Key points**

- The Parliament asks the European Commission to speed up payments and check projects more fairly across countries.
- It wants public lists of the biggest final recipients of money, so citizens and auditors can see who gets it.
- It asks for a clear plan to repay the joint EU debt, and warns that borrowing costs are rising sharply.
